description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework Core classes and implements a thread pool with a nested Dispatcher class for task dispatching. It manages thread pool initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing a worker thread pool with a nested Dispatcher, inheriting from WPEFramework Core classes to manage task execution.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Nested class responsible for dispatching jobs, implementing the WPEFramework's thread pool dispatcher interface.

methods.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the thread pool with specified stack size and starts it.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread pool.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Method to handle the worker pool's idle state; currently an empty implementation.
